import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
from harness import *

D = 4294967295
RE = {'error':'rejected'}
AB = svc(('A',1),('B',2))
IMG_AB = {'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[1,D],[D,2],[D,D]]}   # match(A,B)
IMG_A = {'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1,D],[D,D]]}                # match(A)

def runjob(events, services=AB, limits=None):
    return jrun({'jobs':[job(services, events, limits)]})['results'][0]['events']

st = lambda e,p: {'op':'stage','epoch':e,'policy':p}
co = lambda e: {'op':'commit','epoch':e}
re_ = lambda e: {'op':'retire','epoch':e}
sp = lambda u,s: {'op':'spawn','unit':u,'service':s}
bg = lambda u,r: {'op':'begin','unit':u,'rid':r}
fi = lambda u,r: {'op':'finish','unit':u,'rid':r}
ex = lambda u: {'op':'exit','unit':u}
cl = lambda p,c: {'op':'clone','parent':p,'child':c}
op = lambda c: {'op':'open','connection':c}
sn = lambda u,r,c,s,d: {'op':'send','unit':u,'rid':r,'connection':c,'stream':s,'destination':d}
rv = lambda c,s,u,r,w=None: {'op':'recv','connection':c,'stream':s,'unit':u,'rid':r,'wire':w}
cz = lambda c: {'op':'close','connection':c}
sto = lambda u,r,f: {'op':'store','unit':u,'rid':r,'file':f}
ld = lambda f,u,r: {'op':'load','file':f,'unit':u,'rid':r}
ul = lambda f: {'op':'unlink','file':f}
ins = {'op':'inspect'}
A1 = [0,1,1]; B1 = [0,2,1]

def wire(epoch, state, label, stream, gen):
    import struct
    return struct.pack('>4sIIIII', b'EMC4', epoch, state, label, stream, gen).hex()

base = [st(1,'match(A,B) allow;'), co(1), sp(A1,'A'), sp(B1,'B'), bg(A1,1), op([1,1])]
w1 = wire(1,1,2,1,1)

# ---- open/close -----------------------------------------------------------
check('open generation', runjob([op([1,1]), op([1,1]), op([1,2]), op([1,3]), cz([1,1]), op([1,2]), op([1,3])]),
      [{'ok':True}, RE, RE, RE, {'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, RE])
check('close unknown', runjob([cz([1,1])]), [RE])
check('close wrong gen', runjob([op([1,1]), cz([1,2])]), [{'ok':True}, RE])
check('connection capacity', runjob([op([1,1]), op([2,1]), op([3,1])], limits=dict(LIM, connections=2)),
      [{'ok':True},{'ok':True},RE])
check('generation max', runjob([op([1,U32]), op([1,U32])]), [{'ok':True}, RE])

# ---- send / wire ----------------------------------------------------------
check('send needs context', runjob(base + [sn(A1,2,[1,1],1,'B')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, RE])
check('send basic wire', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':0}])
check('send stream mark', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],2,'B'), sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), sn(A1,1,[1,1],3,'B')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':wire(1,1,2,2,1)}, RE,
       {'ok':True,'wire':wire(1,1,2,3,1)}])
check('send unregistered dest', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'C')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, RE])
check('send wrong conn gen', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,2],1,'B')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, RE])
check('send denied context', runjob([st(1,'match(A) allow;'), co(1), sp(A1,'A'), sp(B1,'B'), bg(A1,1), op([1,1]),
                                     sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_A},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':D},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':wire(1,D,2,1,1)},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,2,1,2]],'units':2,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':0}])
check('send from other unit context', runjob(base + [sn(B1,1,[1,1],1,'B')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, RE])
check('packet capacity', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), bg(A1,2), sn(A1,2,[1,1],2,'B')],
      limits=dict(LIM, packets=1)),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1}, RE])

# ---- recv -----------------------------------------------------------------
check('recv first delivery', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,3]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':0}])
check('recv duplicate same', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), rv([1,1],1,B1,1,None), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,3]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':0}])
check('recv duplicate other rid', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), rv([1,1],1,B1,2)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, RE])
check('recv duplicate other unit', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), sp([0,3,1],'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), rv([1,1],1,[0,3,1],1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, RE])
check('recv duplicate after finish', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), fi(B1,1), rv([1,1],1,B1,1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, {'ok':True,'allow':True}, RE])
check('recv wrong service', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,A1,1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1}, RE])
check('recv no packet', runjob(base + [rv([1,1],1,B1,1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, RE])
check('recv wrong wire', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1,'ab'*24), rv([1,1],1,B1,1,w1.upper()),
                                        rv([1,1],1,B1,1,'  '+w1), rv([1,1],1,B1,1,'zz'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1,None)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1}, RE,
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, RE, RE, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}])
check('recv needs mark raise', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,5), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), bg(B1,1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       RE, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, RE])
check('recv capacity', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1)], limits=dict(LIM, contexts=1)),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1}, RE])
check('recv after close', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), cz([1,1]), rv([1,1],1,B1,1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1}, {'ok':True}, RE])
check('close releases refs receiver survives', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), cz([1,1]), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])
check('send packet survives source finish', runjob(base + [sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), fi(A1,1), rv([1,1],1,B1,1), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True,'wire':w1},
       {'ok':True,'allow':True}, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':0}])

# ---- store / load / unlink ------------------------------------------------
check('store needs context', runjob(base + [sto(A1,2,[1,1])]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, RE])
check('store load unlink', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), ins, ld([1,1],B1,1), ins, ul([1,1]), ins, ld([1,1],B1,2)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':0,'files':1},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,3]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':1,'packets':0,'files':1},
       {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':0,'files':0},
       RE])
check('store overwrite same generation', runjob(base + [bg(A1,2), sto(A1,1,[1,1]), sto(A1,2,[1,1]), ins, fi(A1,1), fi(A1,2), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1}, {'ok':True}, {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,1]],'units':2,'contexts':0,'connections':1,'packets':0,'files':1},
       {'ok':True,'allow':True}, {'ok':True,'allow':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,1]],'units':2,'contexts':0,'connections':1,'packets':0,'files':1}])
check('store other generation rejected', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), sto(A1,1,[1,2]), sto(A1,1,[2,1])]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, RE, RE])
check('store generation hwm survives unlink', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), ul([1,1]), sto(A1,1,[1,1]), sto(A1,1,[1,2]), sto(A1,1,[2,1])]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, RE, {'ok':True}])
check('load wrong generation', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), ld([1,2],B1,1), ld([2,1],B1,1), ld([1,1],[0,9,9],1)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, RE, RE, RE])
check('load capacity', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), ld([1,1],B1,1)], limits=dict(LIM, contexts=1)),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, RE])
check('file capacity', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), sto(A1,1,[2,1])], limits=dict(LIM, files=1)),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, RE])
check('load rid mark', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), ld([1,1],B1,3), ld([1,1],B1,3), ld([1,1],B1,4)]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}, RE, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2}])
check('file survives exit', runjob(base + [sto(A1,1,[1,1]), ex(A1), ld([1,1],B1,1), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True}, {'ok':True}, {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':1,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':0,'files':1}])
check('retire blocked by file reference', runjob([st(1,'match(A,B) allow;'), st(2,'match(A) allow;'), co(2), sp(A1,'A'),
                                                 bg(A1,1), sto(A1,1,[1,1]), re_(1), fi(A1,1), re_(1), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True,'epoch':2,'image':IMG_A},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':2,'state':1}, {'ok':True}, RE, {'ok':True,'allow':True}, {'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':2,'images':[[1,2,1,0]],'units':1,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])
check('store pinned epoch', runjob([st(1,'match(A,B) allow;'), st(2,'match(A) allow;'), co(1), sp(A1,'A'), bg(A1,1),
                                    co(2), sto(A1,1,[1,1]), co(1), ld([1,1],B1,1), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':IMG_AB},{'ok':True,'epoch':2,'image':IMG_A},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2],[2,2,1,0]],'units':1,'contexts':1,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':1}])
